decision: PROMISING narrowly on aligned one-core Givens tasks; independent TT cores required outside orbit
facts: Aligned tasks: Mirror 509 B / functional NRMSE 5.90e-4; LoRETTA-style independent middle TT cores 2,355 B / 4.05e-4; generic PCA 625 B / 4.05e-4.
Mirror payload is ~78% smaller than independent TT core control and ~19% below generic PCA, with slightly higher but still low function error.
Independent TT cores remain accurate (NRMSE 4.01e-4); Mirror NRMSE 1.145 and PCA 0.872.
Mirror coefficient fit takes ~3.85 ms; PCA ~2.27 ms. All factors serialized fp16 and decoded before evaluation.
interpretation: A Givens address on one TT core yields a distinct storage-quality Pareto point for a teacher-aligned adapter family. Generic PCA is near and more accurate; independent tasks require private TT cores. This is a synthetic feasibility result only.
hypothesis: Supported narrowly for aligned task variation inside one shared TT core; not established for general LoRETTA adapters or natural tasks.
counter_hypothesis: The aligned teacher is constructed from the same Givens action; nonlinear learned low-rank codes or longer PCA may match the Mirror byte/quality point.
limitations: No optimizer training or downstream language quality
